color.note: Semantic colour in four themes. The content layer (bg, labels, fills) carries colour; glass stays neutral and borrows colour from what is behind it. Contrast themes are added themes: 7:1 text, solid rims.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page and window background: the content layer everything floats above.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, grouped lists, sheets at full height: content surfaces that sit on `bg`.

tokens.name: bg-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells, code blocks, inset regions and the track of large controls; sits on `bg`.

tokens.name: bg-inverse
tokens.usage: Inverse bands (footers, callouts, the activity capsule) with `label-inverse` on top.

tokens.name: label
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `bg`, `bg-raised` and `bg-sunken`.

tokens.name: label-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text (subtitles, metadata, inactive tab labels) on `bg`, `bg-raised` and `bg-sunken`.

tokens.name: label-tertiary
tokens.usage: Placeholders, captions and timestamps on `bg`, `bg-raised` and `bg-sunken`. Still 4.5:1; use `label-disabled` for disabled text.

tokens.name: label-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels only (exempt from contrast minimums). Never for readable content.

tokens.name: label-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `bg-inverse`.

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between list rows and sections. Decorative in the standard themes; solid in the contrast themes.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Outline of text fields, checkboxes and radios: at least 3:1 on `bg` and `bg-raised`.

tokens.name: fill-1
tokens.usage: Strong control fill: switch track when off, slider track, stepper wells.

tokens.name: fill-2
tokens.usage: Medium fill: segmented control track, gray buttons, chips at rest.

tokens.name: fill-3
tokens.usage: Subtle fill: search fields in the content layer, hover wash on rows.

tokens.name: fill-selected
tokens.usage: Selected row or item wash inside lists, sidebars and menus.

tokens.name: thumb
tokens.usage: The segmented control's selection: its frosted glass at rest (80% of this over the track), solid where glass is not drawn. Labels on it use `label`.

tokens.name: knob
tokens.usage: The white of switch knobs and slider thumbs: the frost of their glass at rest, thinning as they lift, and their solid face where glass is not drawn (with `shadow-thumb`, a solid ring in the contrast themes).

tokens.name: toggle-on
tokens.usage: Switch track when on: a fresher green than `positive-fill`, at least 3:1 against `bg`, `bg-raised` and the white `knob`. Never for text.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Links, selected tab icons and focus accents as text or icon on `bg`, `bg-raised` and `accent-soft`.

tokens.name: accent-fill
tokens.usage: Solid fill of filled buttons, checked switches and progress; always carries `on-accent`.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `accent-fill` and on tinted glass (`accent-glass`).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted wash behind `accent` text: selected chips, info banners, soft badges.

tokens.name: accent-glass
tokens.usage: Tinted glass for the one primary action per view (tinted buttons, the selected tab lens). Label with `on-accent`.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Success text and icons on `bg`, `bg-raised` and `positive-soft`. Always with a check icon or a word.

tokens.name: positive-fill
tokens.usage: Solid success fill (badges, confirmations) carrying `on-positive`.

tokens.name: on-positive
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `positive-fill`.

tokens.name: positive-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted wash behind `positive` text.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons on `bg`, `bg-raised` and `caution-soft`. Always with a warning icon or a word.

tokens.name: caution-fill
tokens.usage: Solid warning fill carrying `on-caution`.

tokens.name: on-caution
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `caution-fill`.

tokens.name: caution-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted wash behind `caution` text.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive labels on `bg`, `bg-raised` and `critical-soft`. Always with an icon or a word.

tokens.name: critical-fill
tokens.usage: Solid destructive fill (delete confirmations, count badges) carrying `on-critical`.

tokens.name: on-critical
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `critical-fill`.

tokens.name: critical-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted wash behind `critical` text.

tokens.name: glass-fill
tokens.usage: Regular glass tint at default density: tab bars, toolbars, glass buttons. Carries `glass-label`.

tokens.name: glass-fill-clear
tokens.usage: Clear glass over photos and video; always paired with `scrim-media` and bold, bright content.

tokens.name: glass-fill-thick
tokens.usage: Thick glass for large surfaces: menus, popovers, sidebars, alerts, sheets at medium height.

tokens.name: glass-fill-solid
tokens.usage: Glass at full density (Reduce Transparency, density 1). Carries `glass-label`.

tokens.name: glass-label
tokens.usage: Text and symbols on any glass fill (regular, thick, solid) over `bg`, and over media once `scrim-media` is applied.

tokens.name: glass-label-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text on regular and thick glass over `bg`.

tokens.name: glass-rim
tokens.usage: Inner hairline that defines a glass edge. In the contrast themes it is the contrasting border.

tokens.name: glass-rim-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary inner rim on the shadowed side of glass.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: Darkened outer edge that separates glass from bright content.

tokens.name: glass-specular
tokens.usage: Specular highlight colour on the light-facing rim; follows the pointer or device tilt. Off in the contrast themes.

tokens.name: glass-glow
tokens.usage: Touch illumination that spreads from the press point through interactive glass.

tokens.name: glass-shade
tokens.usage: Soft inner shade on the lower half of glass that gives it thickness.

tokens.name: lens-rim
tokens.usage: The bright crescent and hairline on the rim of liquid glass: switch knobs, slider thumbs and selection indicators, at rest and lifted.

tokens.name: lens-sheen
tokens.usage: Bloom on liquid glass where its curve faces the light, and the weaker caustic where the light leaves its far side.

tokens.name: shadow-ink
tokens.usage: The colour shadows are mixed from where they change with motion (a knob lifting off its track). Strength per theme comes with the bundle.

tokens.name: media-label
tokens.usage: Glyphs and bold labels on clear glass over media, always with `scrim-media` underneath.

tokens.name: media-label-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text on clear glass over media (timestamps, artists), with `scrim-media` underneath.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Modal dimming behind alerts and full-height sheets.

tokens.name: scrim-media
tokens.usage: Dimming layer under clear glass on media so white glyphs stay legible.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline: 2px solid, 2px offset. At least 3:1 on `bg`, `bg-raised` and glass.

tokens.name: hue-coral
tokens.usage: Coral fill with white glyphs: avatars, list icons, tags, tinted glass.

tokens.name: hue-amber
tokens.usage: Amber fill with white glyphs.

tokens.name: hue-green
tokens.usage: Green fill with white glyphs.

tokens.name: hue-teal
tokens.usage: Teal fill with white glyphs.

tokens.name: hue-sky
tokens.usage: Sky fill with white glyphs.

tokens.name: hue-indigo
tokens.usage: Indigo fill with white glyphs.

tokens.name: hue-violet
tokens.usage: Violet fill with white glyphs.

tokens.name: hue-rose
tokens.usage: Rose fill with white glyphs.

tokens.name: on-hue
tokens.usage: Glyphs and initials on any `hue-*` fill.

tokens.name: scene-sand
tokens.usage: Scene pigment: warm sand highlight in backdrops behind glass.

tokens.name: scene-clay
tokens.usage: Scene pigment: terracotta mass in backdrops.

tokens.name: scene-sea
tokens.usage: Scene pigment: deep sea green in backdrops.

tokens.name: scene-sky
tokens.usage: Scene pigment: pale sky in backdrops.

tokens.name: scene-leaf
tokens.usage: Scene pigment: leaf green in backdrops.

tokens.name: scene-sun
tokens.usage: Scene pigment: sun yellow highlight in backdrops.

tokens.name: scene-ink
tokens.usage: Scene pigment: deep shadow in backdrops and artwork.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Host Grotesk", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
families.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", "Geist Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Heavy, tight and left-aligned. Titles sit in the content layer and scroll under glass.

styles.name: t-display
styles.usage: Marketing heroes and splash screens. One per page.

styles.name: t-large-title
styles.usage: Screen titles in the content layer; collapses into the navigation bar's inline title on scroll.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Body copy is 16px. Secondary information steps down in size and in colour (`label-secondary`), never in weight alone.

styles.name: t-headline
styles.usage: Row titles, emphasized lines, inline navigation titles.

styles.name: t-body
styles.sample: Glass floats above your content and bends the light behind it.

styles.name: t-callout
styles.usage: Supporting copy in cards, alerts and sheets.

styles.name: t-footnote
styles.usage: Footnotes, helper text under fields, list section footers.

styles.name: t-caption-2
styles.usage: Tab bar labels and the smallest legible annotations. Never smaller.

styles.name: t-numeric
styles.usage: Timers, scores and counters: the text face with tabular figures (`font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`), so digits never jitter while counting.

groups.name: Controls
groups.note: Labels on buttons, segments and menus: sentence case, no trailing punctuation.

styles.name: t-control
styles.usage: Button and segmented control labels at md and lg sizes.

styles.name: t-code
styles.usage: Inline code and code blocks on `bg-sunken`.

spacing.note: 4px grid. Floating glass keeps `space-2` (compact) to `space-4` (regular) from the window edge.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside chips; badge offsets.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between grouped glass controls; menu and sidebar padding; floating inset on compact screens.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control inner padding; gap between items in a toolbar.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; screen margin on phones; floating inset on regular screens.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Sheet and dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between groups in a form or list; screen margin on tablets.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Page gutters on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Large section spacing.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Marketing section rhythm.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Hero padding on web pages.

radius.note: Concentric: an inner corner equals its container's corner minus the padding between them. Capsules for controls, rounded rectangles for surfaces.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, keyboard hints, tiny tags.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Thumbnails in rows, inputs in dense layouts, items inside a `radius-lg` container with 10px padding.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Text fields, list icons, menu items inside a `radius-xl` menu with 14px padding.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, grouped lists, sidebar items inside `radius-xl` panels with 8px padding.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, floating sidebars, media cards.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Sheets and alerts; floating panels that hug the window corner.

tokens.name: radius-3xl
tokens.usage: Window-sized glass and device-like frames.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Capsules and circles: glass buttons, tab bars, search fields, chips, switches.

shadow.note: Glass casts soft, wide shadows and carries its own rim light. Contrast themes drop the soft light for solid borders.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Resting floating glass: tab bars, toolbars, glass buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-glass-lifted
tokens.usage: Glass that grew or lifted: open menus, popovers, pressed controls, the thumb of a dragged switch.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Sheets and bottom panels rising from the bottom edge.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Content-layer cards and thumbnails. Not for glass.

tokens.name: rim-light
tokens.usage: The inner rim on every glass surface: a bright top edge plus a faint full hairline.

tokens.name: rim-depth
tokens.usage: Inner shade along the lower edge that gives glass thickness; pairs with `rim-light`.

tokens.name: shadow-thumb
tokens.usage: Knobs and thumbs where glass is not drawn (Reduce Transparency, the contrast themes): switch knob, slider thumb.

tokens.name: shadow-lens
tokens.usage: A custom liquid part fully lifted into a lens. Refract's own knobs and selections mix their shadow from `shadow-ink` so it deepens continuously with the lift.

material.note: The optical recipe of glass. Density (0 clear to 1 solid, default 0.5) is a runtime preference: `--rf-density` or `Refract.setDensity()`.

tokens.name: glass-blur
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur of regular glass controls (tab bars, buttons, toolbars): light enough that the content behind still reads through the lens.

tokens.name: glass-blur-thick
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur of thick glass: menus, popovers, sidebars, sheets. Keep blur under a third of the surface height; small surfaces use `glass-blur`.

tokens.name: glass-blur-clear
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur of clear glass over media: just enough to soften pixels.

tokens.name: glass-saturation
tokens.usage: Saturation boost applied to what is seen through glass, so colour survives the frost.

tokens.name: glass-brightness
tokens.usage: Brightness lift through light glass; dark themes use 0.9 in bundle.css.

tokens.name: lens-bezel
tokens.usage: Width of the curved rim that refracts (the lens bezel). Controls under 40px tall use half their height.

tokens.name: lens-depth
tokens.usage: Maximum refraction offset in px at the rim (feDisplacementMap scale).

tokens.name: lens-frost
tokens.usage: Gaussian frost (stdDeviation) applied inside the lens before refraction.

tokens.name: lens-dispersion
tokens.usage: How far the rim of strong lenses (`data-lens="strong"`, the loupe) splits light into colour: red bends (1 − this) and blue (1 + this) times as far as green. `data-lens-dispersion` sets it on any surface; 0 turns it off.

tokens.name: density-default
tokens.usage: Starting glass density; 0 is ultra clear, 1 is fully tinted.

size.note: Touch targets never drop under 44px on coarse pointers; the visible control may be smaller inside that hit area.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, chips, compact segmented controls (pointer only; pad the hit area to 44px on touch).

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default buttons, fields and segmented controls.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Prominent actions, search fields in bars, touch-first layouts.

tokens.name: control-xl
tokens.usage: Hero actions and the floating compose button.

tokens.name: hit-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target on coarse pointers.

tokens.name: bar-height
tokens.usage: Floating tab bar and bottom toolbar height.

tokens.name: navbar-height
tokens.usage: Navigation bar row with glass buttons.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Floating sidebar width; collapses to `sidebar-rail`.

tokens.name: sidebar-rail
tokens.usage: Collapsed sidebar: icons only.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons in chips, fields and small buttons.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Icons in buttons, rows and menus.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Tab bar and toolbar icons.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Rims and separators; drawn as inset shadows so they follow the radius.

tokens.name: scroll-edge
tokens.usage: Height of the soft scroll edge effect under floating bars.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls (label and fill together).

tokens.name: opacity-dimmed
tokens.usage: Content behind an inline edit or a lifted item.

tokens.name: opacity-hover
tokens.usage: Strength of the hover wash on glass and rows.

zIndex.note: Floating glass sits above content, overlays above glass. Top-layer elements (dialogs, popovers) ignore these.

tokens.name: z-content
tokens.usage: The content layer.

tokens.name: z-scroll-edge
tokens.usage: Scroll edge effect, between content and bars.

tokens.name: z-float
tokens.usage: Floating bars, sidebars and toolbars.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Non-modal overlays (the activity capsule, inline pickers).

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts when the toaster is not in the top layer.

duration.note: Springs carry their own feel; these are the times their curves need to settle.

tokens.name: duration-instant
tokens.usage: Colour and opacity feedback on press and hover.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Small fades: labels, chevrons, tooltips out.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Default fades and slides without a spring.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Scroll edge fades, large cross-fades.

tokens.name: duration-shimmer
tokens.usage: One pass of the skeleton and progress sheen.

tokens.name: duration-spring-smooth
tokens.usage: Settle time of `spring-smooth`; always use the two together.

tokens.name: duration-spring-snappy
tokens.usage: Settle time of `spring-snappy`; always use the two together.

tokens.name: duration-spring-bouncy
tokens.usage: Settle time of `spring-bouncy`; always use the two together.

tokens.name: duration-spring-gel
tokens.usage: Settle time of `spring-gel`; always use the two together.

tokens.name: duration-spring-jelly
tokens.usage: Settle time of `spring-jelly`; always use the two together.

easing.note: Use springs for anything that moves or changes shape; cubic curves for fades.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Default for fades and colour changes.

tokens.name: ease-enter
tokens.usage: Things arriving: fades in, reveals.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Things leaving: fades out, dismissals.

tokens.name: spring-smooth
tokens.usage: Critically damped glide for large surfaces: sheets, sidebars, the morph of a menu out of its button. Pair with `duration-spring-smooth`.

tokens.name: spring-snappy
tokens.usage: Quick settle with a hint of overshoot: selection lenses, segmented thumbs, tab changes, popover growth. Pair with `duration-spring-snappy`.

tokens.name: spring-bouncy
tokens.usage: Playful overshoot for state flips people cause directly: switches, check marks, badges popping in. Pair with `duration-spring-bouncy`.

tokens.name: spring-gel
tokens.usage: The liquid wobble of glass under a finger: press release, drops forming, toasts landing. Pair with `duration-spring-gel`.

tokens.name: spring-jelly
tokens.usage: Jelly for playful moments: buds flying out of a drop, a knob landing with a wobble, a digit bouncing into place. A quarter overshoot and a couple of rebounds. Pair with `duration-spring-jelly`.
